what_these_are: Benchmark reference distributions of component disagreement, used only to say where an observed value sits relative to the benchmark. They are not a calibration set and support no probability statement.

cohortP_disagreement.tsv.population: 65 targets, 58 protein clusters; one engine; 50 candidates per target
cohortP_disagreement.tsv.rows: one per (target, depth); the package reads depth 50 only

cohortE_disagreement.tsv.population: 59 targets, 59 protein clusters; four engines (Boltz-2, Chai-1, RF3, RF2NA); six engine pairs per target
cohortE_disagreement.tsv.excluded: AF3, whose designated output was not verifiable: its designation rule matched two rows for 85 of 118 target-executions
cohortE_disagreement.tsv.produced_by: diag_cross_engine.py under the same frozen protocol

no_reference_for: placement attribution, which is refused rather than banded
